title: Vacancy Matrix Completeness & Partial Matrix Safety Contract

states.VACANCY_MATRIX_COMPLETE: All vertical categories and horizontal reservation quotas audited and verified.

completeMatrixWithZeroRows.justification: Verified complete matrix confirms zero seats allocated for this category bucket.
